notes: Turns 1-5 spent 3-4 clicks per turn re-running unprotected R&D, which only re-sees the same top card, while sitting at 0-2 credits and ignoring Server 1, where Post-Truth Dividend (T2) and Freedom of Information (T6) were scored. On T6 it facechecked a fresh remote with 0 credits into N-Pot, and it stayed broke until Daily Casts and Sure Gamble on T7-9; Tread Lightly on T10 and the Tremolo/Sang Kancil run on T13 did close it out.

The early steals were good, but on T2 it facechecked Vicsek (tag, then Urtica Cipher net damage) and Diviner on R&D with no breakers. It carried the Vicsek tag from T2 to T12 while installing Mystic Maemi, Fencer Fueno and Paladin Poemu for the corp to trash each turn, drew into discards with Steelskin Scarring on T7, and spent T9-T11 on empty Archives runs and clicking credits instead of hitting the advanced Server 2 card while the corp sat at 0 credits.

It clicked for credits almost every turn up to 53 credits, never drew or played the 5-card grip, and never installed a breaker, so Klevetnik (T4) and Paywall (T13, T25; it would not even pay the 1 credit) stopped it. The corp scored Oracle Thinktank on T5 and T6 and Kingmaking on T9 from a one-ice remote, and won on T27 with Artificial Cryptocrash, which had sat 2-advanced in Server 2 while the runner clicked for credits on T26.

A reasonable rig (Odore, Utae, Rising Tide) and good steals of Sericulture and Yagi-Uda, but it ran perpetually at 0-5 credits. On T9 it spent 6 credits breaking Ivik and then jacked out because it could not pay for Diviner, so the corp scored Yagi-Uda on T10 and again on T13 from the same server. On T13 the Urtica Cipher run cost it Rising Tide, though it recovered to win with Fujii on T16.

Aggressive HQ pressure against an open HQ won quickly (Freedom of Information T4, Witch Hunt and Tomorrow's Headline T7, Tomorrow's Headline T10). However, it piled up about 10 tags from Increased Drop Rates and Behold! and never cleared them even after seeing Game Over, and on T8 it facechecked R&D with 3 credits into Starlit Knight.

From T2 to T20 it clicked for credits nearly every turn, reaching 54 credits with an unplayed 5-card grip. It ignored remotes the corp left installed overnight: Yagi-Uda went in on T13 and was scored on T14, and the Yagi-Uda installed on T19 won the game on T20. Its only runs (Server 2 on T7, T10 and T12, Server 4 on T11) showed it could get in cheaply.

The HQ steals through Grubber were fine, but it facechecked R&D on T3 into Capacitor and Server 1 on T7 into Klevetnik without matching breakers. After T10 its economy collapsed to 0-5 credits: it made repeated empty Archives runs (T13, T15, T16, T19, T20) and drew into end-of-turn discards, and it could never contest Server 1, so Next Big Thing (T19) and Artificial Cryptocrash (T22) were scored.

It stole every remote agenda the corp tried (Artificial Cryptocrash T2, Oracle Thinktank T10, T15 and T17, Remastered Edition T13). In between, though, it spent whole turns (T8, T9, T11, T12, T14, T16) clicking for credits with 17-27 credits and a full grip, instead of pressuring R&D/HQ or drawing. On T5 it also ran Vasilisa twice, paying to clear the tag each time.

On T2 it spent all 4 clicks re-running HQ at 0 credits instead of checking the advanced card in Server 1 (Longevity Serum, scored T3). On T5, against Jinteki: Personal Evolution and with a tiny grip after core damage, it played Finality into unrezzed R&D ice, took 3 from Saisentan, and was flatlined by the Personal Evolution damage on the Hybrid Release steal, which was foreseeable.

Against Jinteki it repeatedly facechecked net-damage ice: Knowledge Seeker on HQ (T6), Semak-samun on Server 4 (T8) and Hafrún on R&D (T9). On T5 it left Mavirus untrashed and ran it again on T6. It drew into discards on T9-T10, but the Archives run on T11 right after Longevity Serum binned three agendas was sharp, and it finished with a clean Server 4 steal on T13.

Hitting the Mitosis remote on T2 for Lotus Haze was good. Its R&D runs into Bathynomus on T6, T8 and T11 left it on exactly 0 cards each time, which was very risky against Jinteki: Personal Evolution but paid off with three steals. It was too broke and empty-handed on T9 to contest the Lotus Haze scored on T10.

It applied fast, efficient pressure on the open R&D and HQ (two Oracle Thinktanks, Remastered Edition and Kingmaking by T4) and won on T6. Its only oddity was leaving the Oracle Thinktank tag on from T3, which let the corp trash Daeg, First Net-Cat repeatedly.

It clicked for credits on T1-T4 with a full grip. On T5 it facechecked Saisentan on Server 2 and jacked out after getting through, then ran the known Saisentan again and jacked out again, losing 6 cards for nothing. It ignored Server 1 (Lotus Haze scored T7), and on T9 it ran the known Saisentan with a 4-card grip and was flatlined.

On T1-T4 it made 4-5 runs per turn on unprotected R&D, re-seeing the same top card, at 1 credit. It ignored the naked Server 2 Post-Truth Dividend (installed T3, scored T4). Later it ran R&D through Congratulations! 3-5 times a turn (T9-T10), feeding the corp about 15 credits, while Tomorrow's Headline, Freedom of Information and Stoke the Embers were scored from Server 4 unchallenged.

Docklands Pass HQ pressure and the T10 Maintenance Access/Server 1 Witch Hunt steal won the game. On T5, though, it played Tread Lightly into Ping with no money to break it, and it ran HQ on T7 instead of the fresh Server 1 install (Tomorrow's Headline, scored T8). It also let tags pile up, so Daily Casts was trashed, and on T12 it facechecked Piranhas on R&D while tagged.

On T1-T2 it ran unprotected R&D 7 times, re-seeing the same card, while Yagi-Uda sat in Server 1 (scored T2). After that it clicked for credits to 39 with a full unused grip from T3-T8 and again T13-T17, and let Flower Sermon (T13), Sericulture Expansion (T16) and the game-winning Yagi-Uda (T18) be scored from remotes it never contested.

Stealing Next Big Thing on T1 and the Nanuq/Pantograph R&D run on T5 were strong. However, it ran the known F2P on HQ without breaking it on T2 and again on T7, bouncing Gauss each time, made empty Archives runs on T6, T9 and T10, and let Funhouse tags pile up so the corp kept trashing Telework Contract.

On T2 it ran unprotected HQ 4 times while a 3-advanced card sat in Server 1 behind one unrezzed ice (Flower Sermon, scored T3), and it re-ran the same R&D top card on T3 and T7. From T10 to T14 it clicked for credits up to 33 with an unused grip while Sericulture Expansion (T13-14) and the game-winning Yagi-Uda (T14-15) were installed, advanced and scored in Server 5.

It played solid, purposeful tempo and won on T10 with a Hybrid Release, Flower Sermon (Archives) and Fujii run. Its weaker moves were facechecking two unrezzed ice (Vicsek and Phoneutria) in Server 1 on T3 and bouncing off Tatu-Bola on T6, then skipping Server 1 on T7 with 14 credits, which let Sericulture Expansion be scored on T8.

After two Sure Gambles on T1 it never installed a breaker or played another card, clicking for credits on every turn up to 82 credits. Its only runs bounced off Paywall (T8), Klevetnik (T16) and Capacitor (T21), and the corp scored Artificial Cryptocrash (T17), Next Big Thing (T20) and Kingmaking (T22) from remotes it could not contest.
